# Scripta

> Scripta is an AI-powered social media management platform that helps individuals and teams plan, write, design, and schedule content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Scripta combines AI content generation with multi-platform scheduling, real-time analytics, team collaboration workflows, and brand voice management — all from a single dashboard.

## Core Features

- **AI Studio**: Generate captions, hashtags, images, audio, and full campaign packages from a single prompt using Google Gemini AI.
- **Post Scheduler**: Plan and publish posts across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube with a visual content calendar.
- **Analytics Dashboard**: Track reach, engagement, follower growth, and link clicks across all connected platforms in real-time.
- **Team Collaboration**: Create organizations, invite team members, assign roles, and implement post approval workflows.
- **Brand Voice Management**: Define and maintain a consistent brand voice and tone across all AI-generated content.
- **Multi-Platform Publishing**: Connect and publish to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Threads from one place.

## Technical

- Frontend: React (Vite) single-page application with Tailwind CSS.
- Backend: Node.js/Express REST API with MongoDB.
- AI Provider: Google Gemini (generative text, image, and audio).
- Authentication: JWT-based auth with Google OAuth support.
- Deployment: Docker containers served via Nginx reverse proxy.
